result.report:
Based on your data, the habit most linked with worse sleep is bed_hour, with a correlation of -0.297 and a p-value of 0.0045. This represents strong evidence of an association. Please note that this is an association and not a cause-and-effect relationship.

Regarding your previous experiment on screen_min, which began on 2026-09-29, your sleep quality changed by 0.916. While this change was unlikely to be noise alone, it is still not proof the habit caused it.

For your next step, you should focus on the habit bed_hour. The suggested experiment is: go to bed 30 minutes earlier.

General wellbeing information only, not medical advice. If you have serious or persistent symptoms, see a doctor.
